warnings: Markovci name returned Q749792 in municipality Šalovci; false positive. Correct Q8009642 has conflicting coordinates and is blocked.

Wikidata coordinates are approximate settlement references; even unique QID must be matched to current-year organiser venue evidence.
Some Wikidata P625 precision >= 0.016 degrees is coarse; exact 10km radius is uncertain.
Review was based on actual Master snapshot 2026-11-13; source 2027 venue content may change by release.
